basic_info.description: Within a few blocks of downtown Glen Park on a tranquil cul de sac comes a rare offering, 142 Chilton. This soaring, light-filled home is the most sought after type of San Francisco property. That is a meticulously constructed home, everything built to exacting standards, where a highly acclaimed architect led the way. The stunning design, by Mark English Architecture brilliantly informs throughout the residence. The home is defined by openness, light, volume, and invention. The lovely foyer w/ stairs entry leads toward a totally classic living room, dining room, kitchen, all open to one another. An interior courtyard with dramatic tall windows flows from the dining area. From here the stunning backyard is accessible. A fabulous primary suite also can access the gorgeous garden. Upstairs are 4 brs, 2 ba's plus a laundry room, all with very tall ceilings and terrific light. Downstairs finds huge flexible rooms, a rec room, exercise room, workshop and bike storage. Mature + stunning landscaping surrounds the amazing indoor-outdoor spaces. The location is very nearby (~2 blocks) BART and commuting points, yet it's quiet and serene.
